build_MixMIMPretrainTransformer: build a MixMIMPretrainTransformer backbone with configurable arch, mask_ratio, and window_size for self-supervised pre-training
create_random_masking: create random multi-scale masks at four strides for MixMIM masked image modeling pre-training
test_MixMIM_forward: test the MixMIMPretrainTransformer forward pass with masking enabled to get hidden features and mask tensor
